Inputs: photo 1 = exterior rendering of the front (slightly angled from the right, approx. 10% of the facade base hidden by shrubs - below the 30% occlusion threshold); photos 2-5 = front/left/rear/right elevation drawings (orthographic, frontal); photo 6 = main floor plan. No sheet is rotated, no duplicate sheets.
depth_basis: oblique_only for photos (no side photo); side elevation drawings 3 and 5 used for depth and side openings.

Scale: plan sheet 6 scale 22.88 mm/px from room labels (median of chain scales); elevation sheets share one scale, transferred via the building width: 21.79 mm/px (front/left/right), 21.86 mm/px (rear). Drawn garage doors (9 ft x 8 ft) and the rendering serve as cross-checks.
Grade: all drawings show a level ground line; grade zero = drawn ground line at the front.
Front corners in the rendering are not in the outer 10% of the frame; no wide-angle compression assumed.

Roof: composite - central hip with ridge parallel to the front (10416 mm), two front and two rear cross gables (ridges front-to-back), left side one continuous plane, right side continues as a catslide over the one-storey strip MB-2 with a bell-cast flare above the entry.
